items.topic: COSO ERM — risk appetite vs. risk tolerance
items.ew_cc_preview: Control risk is the risk that a misstatement will not be prevented or detected by internal controls. Risk appetite is a broader strategic governance concept defining how much risk the organization is willing to pursue or retain.

items.ew_cc_preview: Risk avoidance eliminates the risk entirely by discontinuing the activity that creates the exposure. Here, the organization keeps the underlying activity but shifts the financial impact — a transfer, not an avoidance.

assessment.total_learner_pool_impact: 66 unique Certified items (66/2417 = 2.7% of learner pool) with degraded learner feedback. 5 items have wrong/confusing text in the correct-answer slot (DL-008 — HIGH severity). 65 items have missing distractor feedback (DL-026 — MEDIUM severity). 4 items have both DL-008 and DL-026 simultaneously (P1B-C-153, P1-EC-031, P1-ED-016, P1-ED-051). 5 + 65 - 4 co-occurrences = 66 unique QIDs.
assessment.remediation_effort_dl008: ~1 batch of ≤28 items (5 items to clear EW[CC]). Primarily moving text from CC slot to ExplanationCorrect or removing duplicate content.
assessment.remediation_effort_dl026: ~3 batches of ≤28 items (65 items, ~85 empty non-CC EW slots to author). Average 1.3 empty slots per item. Sections C, D, E across Packs B, C, D.
assessment.discrepancy_with_prior_claims: CURRENT_BASELINES.md §3 claims DL-008 '0 verified — RESOLVED S896' (line 112) and DL-026 '0 Certified items' (line 96). BOTH claims are incorrect. The S896 sweep of 59 DL-008 items (22 Pack C + 37 Pack D) did not cover all Certified items — 5 survived. The DL-026 '0 Certified' claim was contradicted by DL-035 (39 Domain F items IN PROGRESS), but the 65 items found here are in Sections C/D/E, NOT Domain F — these were never detected by any prior scan. Root cause: the S853 WAVE_A certification wave (50 Pack C + 50 Pack D Domain E+F) certified items that carried pre-existing DL-008 and DL-026 without detecting them. The subsequent S896 DL-008 sweep targeted specific QID ranges that did not overlap with the Section E items. Packs A and E are truly clean (0/0).
assessment.recommendation: 1) Remaining non-Certified DL-008 items (16 items in Packs C+D Sections E+F, states Active/Archived) are low priority — they are not in the learner pool. 2) The 5 Certified DL-008 items are HIGH PRIORITY — clear EW[CC] immediately (1 batch). 3) The 65 Certified DL-026 items are MEDIUM-HIGH PRIORITY — author distractor explanations for ~85 empty slots (3 batches). 4) Update CURRENT_BASELINES.md §3 to reflect actual state. 5) Update DEFECT_LIBRARY.md DL-008 entry (currently says '0 remaining' — this is false). 6) Update DEFECT_LIBRARY.md DL-026 entry (currently says '0 Certified' — this is false). 7) Audit the S853 WAVE_A certification pipeline to determine why DL-008/DL-026 checks failed to detect these items during certification.
